draft_en.subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution — the data-center client
draft_en.body:
Dear Antonio,

In January you took our CENTEC material (STH25G series, function list V2.4) to a data-center client and kindly offered some feedback. I did not follow up on it, so let me do that now.

If the 25G/100G core is still open on their side: the 48 x 25G + 8 x 100G unit (STH-8C48DX-HSI) is $4,800 USD EXW on the 2026 Q2 list (valid 15 days from this mail), L3 with VXLAN-EVPN, MPLS and MLAG, hot-swap PSUs, with your label if needed.

One question: did the client decide, and if not, what was their feedback on the material?

Thank you.
Alan
